- [RLOW.13.1] **The Rete network is the lowering target.**
  Schemas → schema groups ([RLOW.3.2.1]); rules → a chain of alpha and beta
  nodes ending in one terminal ([RLOW.4.2.1]); patterns and `where` → alpha
  tests and beta join tests ([RLOW.5]); expressions → `Expr` trees
  ([RDSC.4a.9]); actions → the terminal's actions ([RDSC.4a.8]); series →
  backend atoms ([RLOW.8.1.2]). One engine instance per tier instance
  ([RLOW.1.1]).
